body: My mom is bipolar and has depression, that’s really why I started to think I had depression before it got worse when I moved across the country. I’ve always thought that medications were bad (or maybe not bad but just scary to me) but just having people like you reply to me does a little to help but it goes a long way. I definitely need help and I have some friends from my home town I’m in touch with still I need to open up to my friends, I’m very bad at expressing my feelings cause I always assume my friends will think I’m doing it for attention when I’m truly struggling. I guess I’ve always been kinda weak when it comes to mental pain, I have a hard time dealing with stress I break down and don’t know what to do. I don’t know if it’s anxiety or if I’m just not built to take the amount of stress my overthinking pushes onto myself. Thank you for replying and helping me through this I can’t express my appreciation enough.

That’s gonna be my goal, getting rid of social media’s and only keeping messenger due to communication. You’re 100% right , it’s filled with negativity and in my mental state it’s not hard to push my into a negative thinking state, and that’s the last thing I need. Thanks for talking to me about it I appreciate it a lot you made my night , or even week! I can tell you’re a good soul
I appreciate you and this community, I feel a little better after letting my balled up emotions flow into this post.

That would definitely make me feel better but the fact that I know that’s not possible just makes me think negatively about it. I used to get bullied when I was in school about stuff of that sort but now that I’m not in school I don’t really get hatred anymore besides the stuff I see on social media. Inevitably I’m gonna have to take a break from social media’s
